# ml-multi-002

## Instruction
Predict car prices (money) or car ratings based on car features including make, model, year, mileage, and various attributes. Save the predicted car prices or ratings. Available datasets:
- **Car_Rates.csv**: Car ratings (General_rate 1-5) with make/model info
- **New_York_cars.csv**: Detailed car features with prices (money) - 149K+ cars
- **test.csv**: Test data with 26K+ cars (needs prediction target identified) Analyze the datasets to determine the prediction task.
